info.name: 07-CustomerSurfaceValidation
info.description: Customer-facing refund API contracts only, self-contained (creates its own fresh Stripe card ride; no DB/Redis access): fareBreakup menu + its dashboard-route parity twin, refundRequest create guards (empty components, non-owner, single-OPEN), the customer refund list, and evidence upload (unsupported type rejected, image/png accepted after the listed request is closed - a REJECTED request frees the order, so no reset is needed). Asserts routes/status/response shapes and validation, with no money/ledger/invoice assertions.
